issue.title: Crash when parsing dates before 1900
issue.body:
Since upgrading to datekit 2.3.0, my script crashes as soon as I parse a date before 1900.

To reproduce:
```python
from datekit import parse_date
parse_date("1899-12-31")
```

It throws an error and the script exits. Windows 11, Python 3.12.
